answer_1.quote: We introduce RTQA (Recursive Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering), a novel TKGQA framework that decomposes complex temporal questions into sub-questions and performs recursive bottom-up reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are answers to complex temporal questions, which can be either entity names or timestamps, derived through recursive decomposition and reasoning over temporal knowledge graphs.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance using Hits@1 and Hits@10, with breakdowns by question type (multiple, single) and answer type (entity, time).
